text:
Don't forget: while PIBA is authorized to issue a 2-year visa under the updated procedures, it is not required to do so. The decision remains at the discretion of the local office. We expect that 2-year renewals will mainly be granted in straightforward cases that are not currently subject to increased scrutiny or suspicion.

Learn more: https://aic.org.il/breaking-news-major-policy-updates-in-favor-of-international-couples/
